digest.component_or_area: codebase-wide consolidation (store paths, commands, engine, llm, mcp modules)
propositions: The defect review identified duplicated business logic (sidecar keying, git_adapter by-path loads, nested-pytest, comment key/send, compaction) replicated across 2–7 locations, causing fixes to land in only one copy while twins remain broken
Duplicated computations must be consolidated into single shared module implementations, each guarded by a construct-uniqueness test that enforces exactly one definition exists across the codebase

Consolidation children must preserve all pinned observable behaviour (no assertion changes except re-pointing at consolidated owner) and deliver net-negative non-test line count across the collective set

AC2 and AC3 acceptance criteria are stated as proxy metrics (test-additions-only, net-negative-lines) that correct consolidation work legitimately violates; both need restatement to measure intent (no pinned behaviour changes, one implementation per construct) rather than proxy
